info.title: FlowSentinel API
info.description: Metadata-only analysis of authorized packet captures. No endpoint returns packet payloads, and TLS is never decrypted. Every endpoint except POST /auth/login needs a signed-in session; viewers read, analysts also import and triage, admins also delete, change settings, manage accounts and read the audit log.

get.summary: Read the audit log, newest first (admin).

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Only events by this account name.

post.description:
Sets the session cookie and returns the CSRF token. After 5 failures for
one username (or 20 from one address) within 15 minutes, attempts are
refused with `429` until the oldest failure is 15 minutes old.

200.description: Signed in; the response sets the session cookie

401.description: Wrong username or password, or disabled account

429.description: Too many failed attempts; see Retry-After

post.summary: Sign out: ends the session and removes its cookie.

403.description: Missing CSRF token or cross-site request

put.description:
Ends every session of the account, including this one, and starts a new
session for this client: the response sets a new cookie and CSRF token.

400.description: Wrong current password, or the new one is too weak

403.description: Missing CSRF token or cross-site request

429.description: Too many failed attempts; see Retry-After

200.description: The signed-in account and its CSRF token

post.description:
Send the file as the raw request body. It is streamed to a private
temporary file (size-limited), analyzed in two passes, stored as metadata
only in one transaction, and the temporary file is deleted.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description:
Original file name; must end in `.pcap`. Only the final path
component is kept, sanitized and shortened to 128 characters.

requestBody.description: Classic libpcap file, as the raw request body

403.description: Needs the analyst role, or a missing CSRF token

422.description: Not a supported or valid capture

get.summary: Get one capture with its summaries.

delete.summary: Delete a capture and all its stored metadata.

403.description: Needs the admin role, or a missing CSRF token

get.description:
Alerts are heuristic indicators that deserve review, not proof of
compromise. Each carries its evidence, its uncertainty and likely false
positives.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Only alerts of this severity: `low`, `medium` or `high`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Only alerts with this status: `open`, `acknowledged`, `resolved` or
`false_positive`.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: Only alerts of this rule, for example `FS-SCAN-SYN`.

get.summary: Get one alert with its evidence.

patch.summary: Change an alert's triage status. Nothing else about an alert can change.

403.description: Needs the analyst role, or a missing CSRF token

get.summary: List DNS messages of a capture.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Display filter over flow fields, for example `flow.bytes > 1000000`.

get.summary: Get one flow with its full statistics.
List HTTP request and response metadata of a capture.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Display filter over packet fields, for example
`tcp.port == 443 and not ip.addr == 192.0.2.0/24`.

get.summary: Get one packet with its decoded protocol tree.
List visible TLS handshake metadata of a capture. Nothing is decrypted.

200.description: A page of TLS handshake events

get.summary: List the fields a filter may use.
Check a display filter without running it.

400.description: Invalid filter, with the position of the problem

get.summary: Totals across all captures, alert counts and the newest captures.

403.description: Needs the admin role, or a missing CSRF token

200.description: A page of accounts, by username

delete.summary: Delete an account and end its sessions (admin).
delete.description:
Admins cannot delete their own account, and the last enabled admin
cannot be deleted.

409.description: It would leave no enabled admin

patch.summary: Change an account's role, enabled state or password (admin).
patch.description:
Any of these changes ends the account's sessions. The last enabled admin
cannot be demoted or disabled.

400.description: Nothing to change, or a weak password

409.description: It would leave no enabled admin

AlertRow.description:
One stored alert: a heuristic indicator with its evidence. Never proof
of compromise.

evidence.description: `[{"name": ..., "value": ...}]`: the measured facts behind the alert.

mitre_attack.description:
MITRE ATT&CK techniques as context only; not a claim that a technique
was used.

nature.description: Always the same statement that alerts are heuristic indicators.

status_changed_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC: when an analyst last changed the status.

oneOf.description:
For filter errors: the byte range `[start, end)` of the problem in
the filter text.

normalized.description: The filter in canonical form (keywords lowercased, values quoted).

max.description: Largest allowed value, for integer fields.

max_alert_severity.description: `low`, `medium` or `high`: the most severe linked alert.

redacted.description: Credentials, cookies or a query string were present and removed.

password.description: 12 to 256 characters, not containing the username.

username.description: 1 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`; stored lowercase.

recent_captures.description: The five most recent imports, newest first.

csrf_token.description:
Send this in the `X-CSRF-Token` header with every `POST`, `PUT`,
`PATCH` and `DELETE` request.

expires_at.description: When the session ends at the latest (RFC 3339 UTC).

idle_timeout_seconds.description: The session also ends after this many seconds without a request.

visibility.description: Always "visible handshake metadata only; nothing is decrypted".

User.description: An account, without its password hash.

disabled.description: A disabled account cannot sign in, and its sessions end.

UserPatch.description:
Body of `PATCH /users/{id}`. Changing the role, the enabled state or the
password ends the account's sessions.

password.description: A new password, set by an admin.

session.name: flowsentinel_session
session.description: Session cookie set by POST /auth/login (named __Host-flowsentinel_session when FLOWSENTINEL_SECURE_COOKIES=true). State-changing requests must also send the session's CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header.
